title: Tiella di Gaeta
subtitle: Two thin sheets of dough, a filling from the sea or the garden, the oven. We have baked it since 1922.

photo.alt: Whole tielle di Gaeta, just out of the oven, on a tray
photo.caption: Whole tielle on a tray

what.title: What it is
text: The tiella is Gaeta's stuffed pie: two thin discs of dough sealed at the edge and baked in a round tin. It began as the meal of fishermen and farmers, carried onto boats and into the fields, and it is eaten at room temperature. Since 2005 it has carried the town's own designation of origin (De.Co.) and it is listed among the traditional products of Lazio.
